An '''asteroid base''' was located within the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was the site of skirmishes between [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], and [[Linear Miasma Scientists|Linear Miasma]] forces.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
